title: Persistent World-State across Moving Claims
gate_source: EXP-504 Ghost #28: spatial-key drift loses localized manifold memory under motion
pipeline_insertion: [observe] -> estimate_global_motion -> world_frame_key -> track_correspondence -> persist_scene_504(track-keyed) -> next scene

mechanism.problem: S_ent keyed by absolute position; under motion keys drift, every claim looks new, localized memory lost (Ghost #28)
mechanism.solution: re-reference claims to a motion-compensated WORLD FRAME; inter-scene motion estimated from centroid-of-centroids shift; cumulative motion tracked; S_ent keyed by world-frame position (stable track id)
mechanism.dag: hash-indexed correspondence DAG links prior tracks to current claims (matched/new edges)
mechanism.motion_estimate: delta = mean(curr_centroids) - mean(prev_centroids); exact for rigid world motion

observables.track_continuity: fraction of current claims matched to a prior track
observables.healing_under_motion: localized tear on a moving track decays ~alpha_persist per scene
observables.H_dag: P_yz-invariant structural index over the correspondence DAG (counts + size-multiset)

assertions_fork_A: [3] world_frame_key_505 stable: same leaf -> same world-frame key across scenes under motion
[4] RAW504 raw-key continuity ~0 under motion (mean < 0.05) -- Ghost #28
[6] localized memory: TRACK505 per-track S_ent monotone EMA buildup; RAW504 flat (no buildup)
[7] healing under motion: localized tear on a moving track decays geometrically, ratio ~ alpha_persist
[10] track count == leaf count (one track per claim; no track explosion; bounded)
assertions_fork_B: [3] sorted S_ent values fwd == mir (per-track G_ent norms P_yz-invariant) < 1e-10
[4] B_ent_spectral_fwd == mir and healing-under-motion curve fwd == mir < 1e-10
[5] H_dag_fwd == H_dag_mir (size+count index P_yz-invariant); gate_fwd == gate_mir

exp506_gate.trigger: independent per-claim motion (non-rigid): centroid-shift estimate insufficient
exp506_gate.target: nearest-neighbor association in compensated frame within r_gate (spatial-hash buckets); per-track velocity (Kalman-style) prediction
